newsitem.title: EGYPT: Greek president on visit to Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Greek president on visit to Egypt.

text.p: Greek President Costis Stephanopoulos arrived in Cairo on Friday on the first day of his three-day visit to Egypt, airport sources said.
Stephanopoulos had spent most of Friday in the Mediterranean city of Alexandria, founded by the Greek warrior-king Alexander the Great in the 4th century BC.
In Alexandria he visited the Greco-Roman museum and the seat of the Greek Orthodox patriarchate in Egypt.

He will have talks in Cairo on Saturday with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak. Foreign Minister Amr Moussa said they would discuss Middle East peace, Cyprus, Mediterranean cooperation and Egypt's negotiations with the European Union on an economic partnership agreement.
